attacks.claim: The record sends every husband who lacks full capacity to his guardian or curator (CPCA 437) and never cites Family Code 7 ¶2, which gives a husband who married as a minor (under 19, by judicial licence under 7 ¶1) capacity to litigate on the effects of the marriage contract. For such a husband the record tells the lawyer the guardian must file, when the same code says the minor husband can stand in court himself; the record has no slot for the husband's age, so it cannot tell the two cases apart.

source.what: Ordinance 05-02 of 27 February 2005 amending the Family Code, art. 4 rewriting Family Code art. 7, second paragraph; Official Journal 2005 issue 15, page 19

attacks.quoteArabic: يكتسب الزوج القاصر أهلية التقاضي فيما يتعلق بآثار عقد الزواج من حقوق والتزامات
attacks.consequence: Cite family-code 7 ¶2 beside cpca 437 ¶1, ask whether the husband is under 19, and add an open point on whether dissolution counts among the 'effects of the marriage contract'. Do not tell the lawyer that a minor husband must file through his guardian. CPCA 64 and 65 make lack of capacity a nullity the judge raises of his own motion, so a wrong answer either way puts the claim at risk.

attacks.claim: The record never cites the arbitrators (الحكمان): Family Code 56 says that when the dispute grows bitter and no harm is proved, two arbitrators MUST be appointed and must report within two months, and CPCA 446 to 449 organise that step but say the judge MAY appoint them. The record lists the steps between filing and judgment as conciliation (three months from filing in all cases, k41) and then the merits (b20). It says nothing of a second stage with its own two-month period, or of the 'must' in the code against the 'may' in the CPCA.

source.what: Law 84-11 of 9 June 1984 (Family Code), art. 56, Official Journal 1984 issue 24, page 913 (unchanged by ordinance 05-02; the store gives the same text). Also Law 08-09 (CPCA) arts. 446 to 449, Official Journal 2008 issue 21, page 38 (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-arabe/2008/A2008021.pdf)

attacks.quoteArabic: إذا اشتد الخصام بين الزوجين ولم يثبت الضرر وجب تعيين حكمين للتوفيق بينهما ... وعلى هذين الحكمين أن يقدما تقريرا عن مهمتهما في أجل شهرين. / المادة 446: إذا لم يثبت أي ضرر أثناء الخصومة، جاز للقاضي أن يعين حكمين اثنين لمحاولة الصلح بينهما حسب مقتضيات قانون الأسرة.
attacks.consequence: Add family-code 56 ¶1 and cpca 446 to 449 as procedure statements. Add an open point on whether the arbitrators are mandatory (family-code 56) or optional (cpca 446) in a husband's divorce at will. Correct k41 and k42 so they do not present the three-month conciliation as the only stage before the merits.

attacks.target: doc1, doc2, e1, k21, k50, n1
attacks.claim: The record lists documents without saying that every document must be in Arabic or come with an official Arabic translation, on pain of inadmissibility (CPCA 8 ¶2). That leaves a common case unhandled: spouses married abroad before a foreign registrar, holding a foreign-language certificate. The record would ask for doc1 (a civil-status extract) or mark the marriage 'unregistered' (n1, which sends the lawyer to a proof-of-marriage action). It never warns that a foreign certificate filed without an official translation makes the claim inadmissible.

source.what: Law 08-09 of 25 February 2008 (CPCA), art. 8 ¶1-2, Official Journal 2008 issue 21, page 4 (not touched by law 22-13 per the amendment ledger)

attacks.quoteArabic: يجب أن تقدم الوثائق والمستندات باللغة العربية أو مصحوبة بترجمة رسمية إلى هذه اللغة، تحت طائلة عدم القبول.
attacks.consequence: Add cpca 8 ¶2 to the documents (doc1, doc4) with the sanction of inadmissibility, and add a slot or boundary for a marriage concluded or recorded abroad: a foreign certificate needs an official translation, and the lawyer should check whether the marriage was transcribed in the Algerian civil status. Such a marriage should not fall silently into 'registered' or 'unregistered'.

attacks.claim: Boundary n6 tells the lawyer, from Civil Code 338 ¶2 alone, that the court does not apply res judicata of its own motion. The CPCA (2008, the later and procedural text) counts res judicata among the pleas of inadmissibility (art. 67). It obliges the judge to raise of his own motion any plea of inadmissibility that is of public order (art. 69), and to raise lack of standing of his own motion (art. 13 ¶2). A man already divorced from the defendant by a final judgment, with no new contract, is no longer her husband and lacks standing to divorce her. The message understates the risk that the court will dismiss the petition of its own motion.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), art. 13 ¶2 (Official Journal 2008 issue 21, page 4) and arts. 67 and 69 (same issue, page 9)

attacks.quoteArabic: يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الصفة في المدعي أو في المدعى عليه. / الدفع بعدم القبول ... كانعدام الصفة وانعدام المصلحة والتقادم وانقضاء الأجل المسقط وحجية الشيء المقضي فيه / يجب على القاضي أن يثير تلقائيا، الدفع بعدم القبول إذا كان من النظام العام
attacks.consequence: In n6, cite cpca 13 ¶2, 67 and 69 next to civil-code 338. Remove the reassurance that the court will not act of its own motion, or make it an open point (res judicata in personal status and public order). Keep n6 as a warning.

attacks.target: n8, b43, b44, o5, o12, husband_is_foreign_national
attacks.claim: Boundary n8 warns that a foreign husband's national law may govern the divorce. It ignores three Civil Code rules, all rewritten or inserted by law 05-10, that bring Algerian law back. Art. 22 ¶2: a person who also holds Algerian nationality is treated as Algerian, which covers the common dual-national husband who would answer 'yes' to the slot's question «أجنبي الجنسية». Art. 23 مكرر: Algerian law applies when the foreign law cannot be proved. Art. 24 ¶2: Algerian law replaces a foreign law contrary to public order. Art. 21 مكرر also keeps jurisdiction and procedure under the law of the forum. For a dual-national husband the record warns of foreign law that cannot apply.

source.what: Law 05-10 of 20 June 2005 amending the Civil Code: arts. 13, 14, 16 and 17 of the law, rewriting or inserting Civil Code arts. 21 مكرر, 22, 23 مكرر and 24; Official Journal 2005 issue 44, page 20

attacks.quoteArabic: غير أن القانون الجزائري هو الذي يطبق إذا كانت للشخص في وقت واحد، بالنسبة إلى الجزائر الجنسية الجزائرية، وبالنسبة إلى دولة أو عدة دول أجنبية جنسية تلك الدول. / يطبق القانون الجزائري إذا تعذر إثبات القانون الأجنبي الواجب تطبيقه. / يطبق القانون الجزائري محل القانون الأجنبي المخالف للنظام العام أو الآداب العامة.
attacks.consequence: Ask whether the husband also holds Algerian nationality, and do not fire n8 for a dual national (civil-code 22 ¶2). Cite civil-code 21 مكرر, 23 مكرر and 24 ¶2 in n8's message and in o5. Note that the store holds only the 1975 wording of art. 24.

attacks.claim: Open point o5 (grade D) and n8's message rest on the belief that law 05-10 amended Civil Code 13 («its wording in force after the 2005 amendment is not available»). The Official Journal shows that law 05-10 did not touch art. 13: art. 7 of the law rewrites art. 12 (the second paragraph keeps the husband's national law at filing), and art. 8 only adds the new arts. 13 مكرر and 13 مكرر 1. The amendment ledger agrees: it lists 12 'replaced' and 13 مكرر and 13 مكرر 1 'inserted', but not 13. The stored 1975 wording, which refers to arts. 11 and 12, is therefore not displaced by the 2005 law.

source.what: Law 05-10 of 20 June 2005, arts. 7 and 8, Official Journal 2005 issue 44, page 19

attacks.quoteArabic: المادة 8: يتمم الأمر رقم 75-58 ... بالمادتين 13 مكرر و13 مكرر 1 وتحرران كما يأتي / المادة 7: تعدل المادة 12 ... ويسري على انحلال الزواج والانفصال الجسماني القانون الوطني الذي ينتمي إليه الزوج وقت رفع الدعوى.
attacks.consequence: Drop the claim that a 2005 wording of art. 13 exists and is missing. Base o5 on the stored wording (Arabic 'arts. 11 and 12', which since 2005 include the dissolution rule in art. 12 ¶2) and raise its grade. Remove the parenthesis from n8's message. The ledger's sole remaining doubt is commencement (o12).

attacks.claim: Boundary n6 treats the case as clear once 'a new marriage contract was made after' the earlier divorce judgment. The record never cites Family Code 51, under which a man may not take back a wife he has divorced three times until she has married another man and that marriage has ended after consummation; Family Code 30 ¶4 lists «المطلقة ثلاثا» among the temporary impediments. Case: the husband divorced the wife three times by judgment, the two then signed a new contract, and he now seeks divorce. The record would let the divorce petition go ahead with no warning, when the new marriage is void for an impediment (family-code 32) and the right route is annulment (n4).

source.what: Law 84-11 (Family Code), art. 51, Official Journal 1984 issue 24, page 913 (unchanged; the store has the same text). Art. 30 ¶4 (ordinance 05-02 wording) is read from the store

attacks.quoteArabic: لا يمكن أن يراجع الرجل من طلقها ثلاث مرات متتالية إلا بعد أن تتزوج غيره وتطلق منه أو يموت عنها بعد البناء.
attacks.consequence: Add family-code 51 and 30 ¶4 to n6 and n4: when the earlier divorce was the third, a later contract between the same spouses points to annulment, not to divorce. Ask how many earlier divorces there were when spouses_divorced is 'yes' and a new contract was made.

attacks.claim: The record covers only a divorce that the judgment creates now. A common situation is a husband who has already pronounced the repudiation out of court (طلاق عرفي) and asks the court to establish it. Supreme Court case law is reported to read family-code 49 («لا يثبت الطلاق إلا بحكم») as a rule of proof, establishing such a divorce retroactively from the date it was pronounced. That date moves the start of the waiting period (family-code 58 counts it «من تاريخ التصريح بالطلاق»), the maintenance during it, and the wording of the request. The record's r1 asks only for a dissolution from the judgment, and no slot asks whether a repudiation was already pronounced.

source.what: Academic commentary (lead only): R. Boutar (2024), «إثبات الطلاق بين النصوص التشريعية والإجتهادات القضائية», Univ. Souk Ahras; and the M'sila repository study «إثبات الطلاق العرفي وآثاره» (https://depot.univ-msila.dz/handle/123456789/43735). Both report that practice establishes a customary divorce retroactively. No Supreme Court decision number was found on the court's own site.

attacks.quoteArabic: لا يثبت الطلاق إلا بحكم بعد عدة محاولات صلح يجريها القاضي (family-code 49 ¶1) / من تاريخ التصريح بالطلاق (family-code 58 ¶1, Official Journal 1984 issue 24, page 913)
attacks.consequence: Add a slot asking whether the husband has already pronounced the divorce out of court and when. Add a boundary or request variant for establishing a past divorce, with the date of pronouncement. Add an open point, to be checked against the Supreme Court's published decisions, on whether the effects run from that date or from the judgment.

attacks.claim: Item b22 says «لا يعرض القاضي الوساطة في قضايا شؤون الأسرة» / 'The judge does not offer mediation in family cases'. CPCA 994 ¶1 only removes family cases from the judge's DUTY to offer mediation ('must offer ... except'); it does not say he may not offer it. k15 then turns this into 'mediation is excluded in family matters'.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), art. 994 ¶1, Official Journal 2008 issue 21, page 89 (not touched by law 22-13 per the ledger)

attacks.quoteArabic: يجب على القاضي عرض إجراء الوساطة على الخصوم في جميع المواد، باستثناء قضايا شؤون الأسرة
attacks.consequence: Reword b22 and k15: the judge is not required to offer mediation in family cases. Do not state a prohibition that the text does not contain.
